items.title: Mayor’s Announcements
notes: Mayor Guthrie thanked Councillor Caton for bringing Bill C22 to the attention of Council and noted that the Bill has passed.

motions.text: That the minutes of the open Committee of the Whole Meeting held May 2, 2023, Council Planning Meeting held May 9, 2023, Council Orientation and Education Workshop held May 17, 2023 and Council Meeting held May 31, 2023, be confirmed as recorded and without being read.
motions.text_html: That the minutes of the open Committee of the Whole Meeting held May 2, 2023, Council Planning Meeting held May 9, 2023, Council Orientation and Education Workshop held May 17, 2023 and Council Meeting held May 31, 2023, be confirmed as recorded and without being read.

motions.item_title: Committee of the Whole Consent Report
motions.text: That the June 27, 2023 Committee of the Whole Consent Report identified below, be adopted:
motions.text_html: That the June 27, 2023 Committee of the Whole Consent Report identified below, be adopted:

motions.text: That the amended Procedure By-law, included as Attachment-1 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be approved, as amended at the Committee of the Whole meeting held on June 6, 2023. That the amended Closed Meeting Protocol, included as Attachment-2 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be approved. That recommendations three, four, five and six, approved at the June 6, 2023 Committee of the Whole meeting regarding the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be deferred and that the City Clerk, and Strategy, Innovation and Intergovernmental Services staff report back to City Council. That the City Clerk and Mayor be directed to review the current governance framework for the Strategic Advisory Group on Downtown Guelph to ensure compliance with all applicable legislation and report back to City Council as required. That the Delegation of Authority By-law be amended as outlined in Attachment-7 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023 and the Delegation of Authority Noise Exemption Correction Council Memo dated June 27, 2023.
motions.text_html:
1. That the amended Procedure By-law, included as Attachment-1 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be approved, as amended at the Committee of the Whole meeting held on June 6, 2023.
  2. That the amended Closed Meeting Protocol, included as Attachment-2 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be approved.
  3. That recommendations three, four, five and six, approved at the June 6, 2023 Committee of the Whole meeting regarding the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be deferred and that the City Clerk, and Strategy, Innovation and Intergovernmental Services staff report back to City Council.
  4. That the City Clerk and Mayor be directed to review the current governance framework for the Strategic Advisory Group on Downtown Guelph to ensure compliance with all applicable legislation and report back to City Council as required.
  5. That the Delegation of Authority By-law be amended as outlined in Attachment-7 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023 and the Delegation of Authority Noise Exemption Correction Council Memo dated June 27, 2023.

motions.name: Additional Motion
motions.text: That, in order to continue ten (10) minute delegation times at Council Planning, an additional clause be added to section 4.8 of the proposed Procedure By-law as follows: 4.8 (u) - Notwithstanding Section 4.8 (a), the time limitation for delegations speaking at a public meeting to hear applications under the Planning Act, shall not exceed ten minutes. Council may extend the ten minute time period by a majority vote of the Council Members present without debate.
motions.text_html:
1. That, in order to continue ten (10) minute delegation times at Council Planning, an additional clause be added to section 4.8 of the proposed Procedure By-law as follows:

4.8 (u) - Notwithstanding Section 4.8 (a), the time limitation for delegations speaking at a public meeting to hear applications under the Planning Act, shall not exceed ten minutes. Council may extend the ten minute time period by a majority vote of the Council Members present without debate.

motions.name: Additional Motion
motions.text: That the Procedural Bylaw, included as Attachment-1 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be amended to add the singing of O Canada, silent reflection and First Nations acknowledgement to all meeting types.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Procedural Bylaw, included as Attachment-1 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be amended to add the singing of O Canada, silent reflection and First Nations acknowledgement to all meeting types.

motions.name: Additional Motion
motions.text: That Section 4.10 Motions and Order of Voting c) be amended to include “and that it be read aloud” so the new clause reads: “When a Councillor moves a motion or an amendment to a motion that is not included as part of the agenda package, that Councillor shall provide a copy of the motion to the Mayor or chair, and that it be read aloud, prior to the vote being taken.”
motions.text_html:
1. That Section 4.10 Motions and Order of Voting c) be amended to include “and that it be read aloud” so the new clause reads:

“When a Councillor moves a motion or an amendment to a motion that is not included as part of the agenda package, that Councillor shall provide a copy of the motion to the Mayor or chair, and that it be read aloud, prior to the vote being taken.”

motions.name: Additional Motion
motions.text: That Table 3, row 1.2 of the Delegation of Authority By-law, included at Attachment-7 to the 2023 Governance Review dated June 6, 2023, be amended to return the noted limitation to five years.
